topic: The special effects so realistic the FBI opened a criminal investigation
hook: The effects were so real, the FBI launched a criminal investigation.
script: The effects were so real, the FBI launched a criminal investigation. When Ridley Scott submitted Gladiator for awards consideration in 2001, MPAA officials flagged several scenes of crowd violence as potentially containing real footage of injury. The FBI confirmed it was all CGI. The same year, the film Saving Private Ryan's D-Day sequence was reviewed by the Department of Defense to confirm no real wartime footage had been illegally licensed. Follow for films so real they fooled the authorities.
